title: Eight years of web design, and the next course for November
punchline: Five looks in eight years ended in one cell that tool prompts steer every page toward: warm paper, serif display, one clay accent. Anthropic set it 2023-06, the pack reached it 2026, and Anthropic's own frontend-design skill named it a cliche on 2026-08-27. Palettes churn in months on prompt plumbing, so the next course is what no prompt steers toward: a field that is neither near-black nor near-white, type the cookbook does not list, and a structure that refuses the centered hero instead of repainting it.

eras.name: Gradient on white
eras.signature: White field, a multi-hue pastel accent set (Stripe #6772e5 indigo with #87bbfd sky, #b9f4bc mint, #f6a4eb pink), light-weight 300-600 geometric or humanist sans (Camphor at Stripe), an angled gradient hero (recalled, never snapshotted), flat Corporate Memphis figures on pastel. Docs sites were teal-on-white (Tailwind 2018 #6dd7b9). Neumorphism (coined 2019) and glassmorphism (Big Sur 2020) ran alongside on Dribbble and never reached a production site any lane sampled.
eras.led_by: Stripe (snapshots 2018-06, 2019-06), Facebook's Alegria by Buck (2017), Slack/Dropbox/Mailchimp illustration systems (recalled only).
eras.what_ended_it: Stripe swapped Camphor for Soehne in 2020, the neutral geometric grotesk many tech sites were favoring (Fonts In Use); Vercel and Linear went dark the same year (snapshots 2020-06). Corporate Memphis collapsed into parody by 2022-2023. Neumorphism died on contrast; glass shrank to a component effect.

eras.name: Dark monochrome dev tool
eras.signature: Near-black field (#1c1d1f), hairline borders (#eaeaea, 17 uses on Vercel 2020), one saturated brand color (Linear #5e6ad2 indigo; Vercel #0070f3 with #79ffe1 mint and #ff0080 magenta pops), soft grey text (#8a8f98), geometric sans (Geist classes on Vercel; Inter confirmed on Linear/Vercel from 2022), product screenshot under a three-word title (Develop. Preview. Ship.).
eras.led_by: Vercel and Linear. Neighborhood lane holds the 2020-06 and 2021-06 snapshots; the look is on disk in June 2020, earlier than the 2021 and 2024 dates other lanes recalled.
eras.what_ended_it: Its own escalation. By 2022 the single brand color became a radial glow and the headline itself became a gradient; dark-by-default stopped differentiating once OS dark mode and every dev tool had it.

eras.name: Glow
eras.signature: #000212 field with violet radial glows (#6663f6, #7877c6) and Inter (Linear 2023-06); animated gradient text per headline word (Vercel 2022-06); code-editor syntax palettes as ornament (Supabase 2022, #3ecf8e on dark with Monokai); Tailwind's own docs going #0c1120 navy with #38bdf8 sky (2023-06); Framer templates standardising Inter plus blue/violet (154 Inter uses, 2023). Neobrutalism (Figma, Gumroad) as the counter-current, reported but never snapshotted. Bento was listicle vocabulary; none of the sites credited with it ran a bento homepage.
eras.led_by: Linear, Vercel, Supabase, Tailwind, Framer. Anthropic was already the outlier: the 2023-06 snapshot shows #fafaf7 off-white, #cc785c clay, Styrene plus Tiempos while everyone else was on glow.
eras.what_ended_it: AI generators learned it as modern SaaS. Linear dropped the purple (2025-06 snapshot: near-pure grayscale). Commentary (LogRocket 2024-25, Overpass 2025-12) named the sameness. The reference leader moving to warm paper in 2023 gave the pack somewhere else to go.

eras.name: Grayscale screenshot and the indigo default
eras.signature: Two things at once. Leaders: glow receded, palettes went grayscale with tiny spot accents, product UI became the decoration (Linear 2025 is a 2.4MB page of screenshots; Vercel 2024 logo walls). The long tail: shadcn dark themes with Tailwind chip colors (Smithery 2024-12 on #1e1e1e; MCP.so 2025 #ff4d94 plus indigo-500 #6366f1) and the unguided AI page: Inter, purple-to-indigo gradient on white, centered hero with eyebrow and two CTAs, three rounded cards, one border-radius and one rgba(0,0,0,.1) shadow on everything, Lucide icons (Anthropic's own admission 2025-11; Wathan's bg-indigo-500 apology 2025-08; v0/Bolt/Lovable comparison 2026-06). The vibe-coding builders' own sites were gradient-saturated (Lovable 2025: #ff8e63 to #4b73ff; Cursor 2025: orange/magenta stops).
eras.led_by: shadcn/ui and Tailwind defaults, Next.js shipping Geist, v0, Lovable, Bolt, and the MCP/plugin registry gold rush.
eras.what_ended_it: The slop meme. Once purple-gradient-on-white was a named tell, the correction went into tool plumbing: v0's prompt forbidding indigo (2025-03), Anthropic's cookbook blacklisting Inter/Roboto/Arial and then warning that Space Grotesk is the new convergence, the frontend-design skill (825k installs by 2026-08), avoid-ai-design's 67 tells, Anti-AI-UI. Output was rerouted, not freed.

eras.name: Warm paper
eras.signature: Cream or warm off-white field (#f0eee6 Anthropic, #fcfbf8 Lovable, #F4F1EA per Anthropic's skill), serif display over a sans body (Anthropic Serif; Cursor's Iowan Old Style/Palatino stack; Playfair Display on PluginMarketplace.ai and on 36.6% of a 131-site Lovable gallery; --font-serif on Build with Claude), one clay/terracotta/rust accent (#d97757, #cc785c, #c96a50, #9a4a3a, #e8533e), warm greys, tracked all-caps mono eyebrows, hairline rules, low radius. Dark sibling: near-black with one acid-green or vermilion. Serious sibling: the broadsheet (hairlines, zero radius, dense columns). Headline vocabulary moved to agents (Vercel 2026 Agentic Infrastructure, Smithery Give agents more agency).
eras.led_by: Anthropic (seeded 2023-06, custom serif by 2026-08), then Cursor (2026-09, verified), Lovable (2026-09, thin tokens), Build with Claude (2026-08), PluginMarketplace.ai (2026-06), Zed's cream landing (2023-06) as an early dev-tool case.
eras.what_ended_it: Not ended, but its end is being manufactured: Anthropic's own frontend-design skill lists cream/serif/terracotta, black/neon and broadsheet as the three looks AI clusters around, in print by 2026-08-27 (Skillselion). A cell named as a cliche by the tool that produces it has 6-18 months, on the indigo precedent.

convergence.name: Warm Paper (the anti-slop cell)
convergence.set_in: Anthropic, on disk 2023-06-01: #fafaf7 field, #191919 ink, #cc785c clay, Styrene A/B for UI, Tiempos Text for reading. Mainstream by mid-2026: Cursor 2026-09 (warm neutrals #edecec/#14120b, Iowan/Palatino serif stack), Lovable 2026-09 (#fcfbf8, Camera Plain Variable), Build with Claude 2026-08 (serif headline, #9a4a3a rust), PluginMarketplace.ai 2026-06 (Playfair Display, #e8533e). Codified as cluster 1 in Anthropic's frontend-design SKILL.md by 2026-08.
traits: Serif display at weight 400 with negative tracking over a neutral sans body: Anthropic Serif/Tiempos, Playfair Display, Iowan Old Style/Palatino, Camera Plain; body Inter, Styrene, Geist or system sans
One warm single accent, clay to vermilion: #d97757, #cc785c, #c96a50, #9a4a3a, #e8533e
Warm greys for secondary text (#b0aea5, #87867f) and slate ink (#141413, #191919), with full-bleed black bands alternating with cream sections
Template chrome, per SKILL.md item 5: tracked-out all-caps eyebrows, mono data labels, middle-dot meta strings, arrow suffixes on links, tinted near-blacks #0B0B0B/#111
Hairline rules and low or zero radius replacing the rounded card; or, unchanged from the prior default, the SaaS card kit with one radius and one rgba(0,0,0,.1) shadow
Dark sibling: near-black with a single acid-green or vermilion accent (named cluster, no measured prevalence)
Serious sibling: broadsheet layout, dense newspaper columns, hairlines, zero radius (named cluster, weakest evidence, and the cell 626's October theme sits in)

Structure unchanged under the new paint: centered hero with eyebrow, headline, subhead, two CTAs; logo wall or count; feature grid; CTA; footer. Only 19.1% of the curated Lovable gallery centers text, so the structure holds for defaults, not for edited output
Space Grotesk as the drift face under Inter-avoid prompts (Anthropic cookbook), Geist as the Next.js/shadcn plumbing face (FontLark, Sailop), Inter as the long-run floor
JetBrains Mono as the mono (Anthropic's own fallback stack), CLI install snippets as hero furniture
convergence.why: Second-order negation, hard-wired into tooling. The 2024-2025 AI default (Inter, indigo-to-purple gradient on white, centered hero, three rounded cards, one radius) descends from Tailwind UI's bg-indigo-500 demos (2019-2020) and the Next.js/shadcn boilerplate saturating training data. Once the default was a meme (Wathan's apology 2025-08, Anthropic's own Inter-fonts-purple-gradients admission 2025-11), the correction was written into the plumbing: v0's prompt bans indigo, Anthropic's cookbook blacklists Inter/Roboto/Arial and recommends Playfair/Fraunces/Newsreader/Crimson Pro, the frontend-design skill (825k installs by 2026-08) describes the failure modes, avoid-ai-design and Anti-AI-UI list the tells. A rule that says not X with a shared list of try Y sends every tool-steered page to the same Y: paper instead of white, serif instead of grotesk, one warm accent instead of indigo, hairlines instead of rounded cards. The Y it inverts toward is Anthropic's own brand, warm since 2023-06 while the field was on #000212 glow. Templates, shadcn and vibe-coded output carry it in months, where Linear's dark recipe took four years to become sameness. Palette and type churn on prompts; the structure underneath sits on training priors and did not move at all.

where_626_sits: Shared with the convergence, plainly: Space Grotesk is the face Anthropic's cookbook says Claude drifts to under Inter-avoid prompts; Inter is the long-run AI body floor; JetBrains Mono is Anthropic's own mono fallback; cyan on dark navy is Tailwind sky-400 on slate-900, the Brittany Chiang portfolio template held 2022-2026; the chrome (tracked all-caps eyebrows, mono data labels, middle-dot meta, arrow links, +0.12em tracking) is SKILL.md item 5 nearly verbatim; card-per-product sections in hero/features/CTA order are the structural default every lane names. October's Slate Broadsheet lands inside the warm-paper wave (warm ink #F7F5F0, serif body, paper grain, matte, hairline and heavy rules, folio tabs) and specifically in SKILL.md cluster 3 (broadsheet hairlines, zero radius, dense columns), in print as a cliche on 2026-08-27, five weeks before the theme went live on 2026-10-01. That is the measure of only slightly ahead: a good read of the anti-slop turn, shipped after the turn was named. What is real distance: the method exists nowhere in the roughly 40 sites sampled (a theme a month with a stated thesis, retired themes frozen at dated URLs, a gate that can refuse a rotation); the slate ground #3A4350 is the only field in the sample that is neither near-black nor near-white; cyan plus magenta as a paired accent where the pack runs one clay; the page is printed, not lit as a thesis where the pack has a palette; and Phosphor Blueprint (CRT scanlines over a drafting grid on #050c18) was a distinct object even though its kit was stock. Net placement: type stack inside the pack; palette value one step off; structure (cards, section order, twelve SITE_JSON zones) in the pack; method two steps off and the only thing no tool prompt can reproduce. Caveats: two themes is two data points; 626's earliest Wayback capture is 2026-04-27, so its own drift cannot be measured; the neighborhood lane read tokens from source, not rendered pages, so composition claims about the pack are inferred.
lag: The retrospectives lane could not reach Wayback, so what it measured is the roundup corpus, a trailing indicator that recycles itself: ObjectStyle (2022-12) predicted a serif comeback, visible borders and brutalism; Markup.io (2024-02) shipped a 14-item list whose intro still said 2023; DepositPhotos (2025) lists neubrutalism, glassmorphism, claymorphism and bento, all 2020-2023 names. Against the one lane with snapshots, the lag runs at two speeds. Leader to named sameness, pre-AI: Linear's indigo-on-near-black is on disk 2020-06, the glow is fully formed 2023-06, LogRocket dates the recipe to 2024, Overpass calls it why every SaaS site looks the same on 2025-12-17: four to five years. Roundup to leader to pack, warm paper: serif comeback predicted 2022-12, Anthropic already on it 2023-06, the pack (Cursor, Lovable, directories) arrives 2026: three years. The AI layer compresses the back half: indigo-500 seeded 2019-2020, the default by 2025, apologized for 2025-08, and the anti-slop cells it provoked (cream/serif/clay, black/neon, broadsheet) were named as cliches in Anthropic's skill by 2026-08, inside a year of their rise. Palette and type defaults churn in months because they sit on tool prompts; structure (centered hero, three cards, one radius, chrome labels) sits on training priors and has not moved since 2020. For a theme shipping 2026-11-01: anything a 2026 roundup predicts is already shipped; anything Anthropic's skill names is already a cliche (October proves it: named 2026-08-27, live 2026-10-01); the window worth aiming at is a leader's 2024-2025 move the pack has not followed, or a cell no tool prompt steers toward at all, which today means mid-value and saturated fields, data-as-design, owned variable type, and refusing the structure rather than repainting it. A theme lives one month and freezes, so it can be a bet the pack never adopts; the cost of being wrong is one dated archive page, and the cost of being safe is landing in the pack again five weeks late.

directions.name: Cyan Ground
directions.thesis: The field stops being a neutral and becomes the brand color itself: 626's #17d4fa cyan as the whole ground, navy #0f1f31 as ink, magenta #f22f89 as a single printed band, set in Archivo (wdth axis: Expanded for display, Narrow for folio tabs) over Hanken Grotesk body and Fragment Mono for data, a saturated mid-value page that no tool prompt currently steers toward and no sampled site runs.
rejects: Cream or warm off-white field
Near-black field and tinted near-blacks #0B0B0B/#111
One clay/terracotta accent
Serif display as the human signal
Glow, gradient hero and grain texture
Space Grotesk display and Inter body
evidence_it_is_coming: Single-accent intensity is rising while the ground stays bipolar: Lando Norris (Awwwards SOTY 2025) is #111112 black with #D2FF00 as the whole identity accent; Raycast 2024-25 moved from gradients to #FF6363 red with noise; Smithery 2026 dropped the shadcn dark default for #ff8c32/#ff5601 orange (snapshot 2026-08)
626labs.dev October 2026: #3A4350 slate, the only mid-value field in roughly 40 snapshots, is the first step off the two poles; a saturated ground is the second
Dropped pending re-verification: Josh W Comeau 2026 (#e7c400 gold not found in any findable token snapshot) and Rauno Freiberg 2026 (could not be verified)
directions.risk: Reads as 2016 flat-campaign duotone (Spotify/Lyft lineage) if the type is not doing the work. AA arithmetic: navy #0f1f31 on #17d4fa clears at roughly 9.3:1, but magenta #f22f89 on cyan is roughly 2.1:1 and on navy roughly 4.4:1, so magenta is band-only at display sizes and can never be link ink; the contrastPairs list has to say so. Brand rasters and OG cards go cyan via the raster block and may fight product screenshots. Long reading pages (reading.css, about.html) need a quieter ground or the theme fatigues at 390px.
directions.verdict_reason: Zero of the five external signals is a saturated-color ground: Lando Norris is #111112 black with #D2FF00 accent (Awwwards listing and OFF+BRAND case study both say accent-on-dark), Raycast is #07080a with #FF6363 confined to the hero stripe, Smithery renders light-ground with teal/orange accents, Comeau's only findable token snapshot is #0e0e10 with pink/gold/blue still present, and Rauno could not be verified. Every verified signal is one loud accent on a neutral pole, which is the convergence's own trait list; the step from accent getting louder to accent becomes the field is the direction's own inference, and it concedes no sampled site runs it. 2026 trend press (Wix, Figma, Envato dopamine design) frames bold color as accents against neutral bases. On the lab's side it is new: no exploration in Design/explorations/ or the specs uses cyan as a field, and the Field Manual sheet explicitly forbids color flood. It is also a known print/campaign lane (Swiss poster, 2016 duotone) rather than a next course.
directions.survives_as: A differentiation bet, not a trend read: no sampled site and no tool prompt uses the brand color as the whole ground. Evidence rewritten as single-accent intensity rising while the ground stays bipolar. Comeau and Rauno citations dropped until re-verified, Lando framing corrected to accent-on-black, and the AA/magenta-band and reading-page concerns treated as the actual gate for whether it ships.

directions.name: Refraction
directions.build_lift: medium once refraction is demoted to one accent; heavy as originally scoped
directions.thesis: Glass comes back as a first-party OS material (Liquid Glass, WWDC 2025) and the web will chase it, so the bet is a refracting nav and card layer (backdrop-filter plus SVG feDisplacementMap lensing) over a LIGHT, colored ground: a cyan-to-white field with navy ink, Familjen Grotesk display, Public Sans body and Fragment Mono, the opposite surface from both the Linear-era dark glow and the matte printed page.
rejects: Matte, printed, grain-textured surfaces (Slate Broadsheet's own thesis)
Cream field plus serif plus clay
Near-black field with violet glow
Flat one-radius cards with a grey shadow
Static frosted panels on dark (the 2021-2024 glassmorphism card)
evidence_it_is_coming: Apple Liquid Glass, WWDC 2025 (session 219, TechCrunch 2025-06-09): system-wide material that refracts and re-tints the background and shifts with scroll or tilt; real refraction lives in Apple's stack, so the web version is a chase
Glassmorphism persisting as a component effect for five years rather than dying (designstudiouiux on Big Sur 2020; DepositPhotos 2025 still listing it)
Linear 2024 glassmorphism effects in the LogRocket recipe, made more subtle by 2025: the dark version is spent, the light version untried in this sample
Awwwards SOTY 2023-2025 rewarding WebGL and Rive material work (Lusion v3, Igloo Inc, Lando Norris), which is 3D work rather than glass
directions.risk: Possibly dead on arrival: The Ad Pharm lists glassmorphism among Claude Design's default output and LogRocket files glass under the Linear recipe, so a judge could call it 2024 in new clothes. Blur cost at 390px. Gate mechanics: contrastPairs resolve to solid channel values and scripts/css_color.py does not composite translucent panels (docstring lines 49-53), so every pair has to be declared against a solid fallback color or theme-doctor fails the rotation. The horizontal-scroll check is not fine with displacement filters that overflow. Awwwards taste is not the plugin-directory audience's taste.
directions.verdict_reason: The anchor signal is real and multi-sourced, but Apple itself retreated twice: iOS 26 beta 3 frosted the material over readability complaints (2025-07-07) and iOS 26.1 beta 4 added a Tinted toggle that flattens it further. Fifteen months on, web-side evidence is tutorials, generators, GitHub topics and trend listicles; the only named production adopters are Figma's app chrome and one anonymous e-commerce header. Two of the direction's own citations overstate: LogRocket's 2025 Linear update says more subtle glassmorphism, not dropped, and the Awwwards SOTY trio is WebGL/3D work, not glass. The Ad Pharm piece does list generic glassmorphism in Claude Design's default-slop output, and the lab already built a backdrop-filter glass sheet (Aurora Depth, Design/explorations/2026-07-07-treatments) and passed on it for Phosphor Blueprint. css_color.py states alpha is not modelled, and feDisplacementMap-on-backdrop is reliable in Chromium only, so Safari and Firefox visitors get a plain frosted panel: the 2021-2024 card the direction claims to reject, now on a light ground.
directions.survives_as: The light, colored ground is the genuine counter-position: a cyan-to-white field with navy ink, Familjen Grotesk / Public Sans / Fragment Mono, is a real third surface against both the near-black glow and the cream/paper cell, and the lab has not tried light-ground glass. Build that as the thesis. Demote refraction from a system-wide nav-and-card material to at most one hero or nav accent with a solid-color fallback declared in contrastPairs, horizontal-scroll checked at 390px, and a no-filter rendering that still reads as the theme. If the accent cannot survive its own fallback, cut it and the direction still enters on the ground alone.

directions.name: One Face, Four Axes
directions.thesis: Owned type is the move every leader made (Soehne, OpenAI Sans, Anthropic Serif, Camera Plain) and a solo lab cannot commission a face, so the bet is one variable family with axes nobody else pushes, Recursive (MONO, CASL, wght, slnt, CRSV), set so display runs the casual axis, body runs linear sans, and code and meta run the mono axis, retiring Space Grotesk, Inter and JetBrains Mono for the month on the existing navy #0f1f31 / cyan / magenta so the only thing that changes is the thing the cookbook says everyone shares.
rejects: Inter or Geist body (the AI floor)
Space Grotesk display (named by Anthropic's cookbook as the drift face)
Serif display as the human signal, Playfair in particular
A separate mono face for small tracked labels
The cookbook's recommended replacements (Fraunces, Newsreader, Bricolage, Satoshi, Clash), which are the next attractor
evidence_it_is_coming: Stripe 2020: Camphor to Soehne as a deliberate identity move (Fonts In Use), though toward retail, not custom
OpenAI 2025: commissioned OpenAI Sans from ABC Dinamo (2025-02), imperfect O for warmth, wordmark over symbol
Anthropic 2026-08: custom Anthropic Serif display face in the snapshot (Anthropic Type family, Chester Jenkins/BSPK)
Lovable 2026-09: Camera Plain Variable confirmed in the font file name (Dinamo retail)
Cursor 2026-09: serif stack in the snapshot; the Kimera refresh adds a custom CursorGothic, and the serif is retail JJannon (Optimo)
Anthropic cookbook 2025-26 and FontLark/Sailop 2026: Inter, Geist and Space Grotesk named as fingerprints; the face is now the tell, so the face is the lever
directions.risk: Recursive is free and could itself become an attractor; today it is on no cookbook list and in no lane's sample. A single family can read monotone unless the CASL and MONO axes are pushed hard between display and body. An unsubsetted variable TTF is several hundred KB against the four files in fonts/ now. The raster exporters (export-brand.py:223, build-og-cards.py:217) hardcode Space Grotesk outside the theme contract, so OG cards and banners would stay in the old face unless the exporters learn a per-theme face; that is a scripts change, not a theme change.
directions.verdict_reason: The face-is-the-tell half is real and multi-source: the cookbook says Claude still tends to converge on Space Grotesk and bans Inter/Roboto/Arial/system; FontLark and aiskill.market independently name Inter then Space Grotesk; OpenAI Sans and the Anthropic Type family are confirmed commissions; Cursor's refresh adds a custom CursorGothic. But owned type is the move every leader made is half wrong: Stripe moved AWAY from custom Camphor to retail Soehne, Lovable's Camera Plain is Dinamo retail, Cursor's serif is retail JJannon, and Comeau's mono is Cartograph CF, not League Mono. Recursive's nobody-pushes-these-axes claim is weaker than stated: the MONO/CASL display-vs-body trick is Recursive's own Google Fonts launch demo (2020, HN front page), with 7 catalogued uses on Fonts In Use, 5 of them 2019-2020 type-nerd/dev-tool sites, so it reads as a known developer-tool face. Structurally it is the cookbook's own mechanism one step further (not X, pick an unlisted Y) on the unchanged July navy/cyan/magenta base with the hero/cards/chrome untouched, and it discards every trait the lab's Field Manual sheet actually has, so it is not a Field Manual remix.
directions.survives_as: A type-axis experiment inside the Field Manual remix, not a standalone course: keep the paper, serif prose and plates, and run Recursive on the MONO axis for the manual's tabular/label/meta work (replacing JetBrains Mono only), with the CASL axis reserved for one display role, judged in the bake-off against the two other styles. Prerequisites: subset the variable TTF, and teach export-brand.py:223 and build-og-cards.py:217 a per-theme face before any theme can retire Space Grotesk. Re-check Fonts In Use and the AI font lists in three months; if Recursive appears on a cookbook-style list, the bet is dead.

directions.name: Live Instrument
directions.folds_into: whichever remix wins, as a render-time-stamped version strip
directions.thesis: The home page stops being a brochure and becomes a panel of 626's own live numbers (data/site-stats.json, store-analytics.json, plugin-versions.json, downloads.csv, all already in the repo) set in Martian Mono at display size with tabular figures, dated stamps and sparklines, Schibsted Grotesk for prose, on a cool panel #2B3440 with cyan as the live indicator and magenta as the alert, so the design is the data and nothing a template or a prompt can forge.
rejects: Centered hero with eyebrow, headline, subhead and two CTAs
Three-card feature row and the one-radius/one-shadow card kit
Product screenshot as the decoration
Sparkle icons, Lucide set, decorative 01/02/03 numbering
Serif display
Mono reserved for small tracked labels (here it is the display face)
evidence_it_is_coming: Directories compete on counts as hero furniture: Glama 2026 69,796 servers (94,748 live today), Build with Claude 2026 28,500+ plugins, Smithery Browse 24,559+ MCPs, ClaudePluginHub largest directory (snapshots 2026-06 to 2026-08)
Linear 2025-06: a 2.4MB page where product UI is the entire decoration; the product became the page
Vercel 2026 Agentic Infrastructure and Smithery 2026 Give agents more agency: headline vocabulary moved to agents, which is what 626 actually ships
UW arXiv 2603.13036 (Shin et al., 2026-03-13): proposes productive friction against vibe-coding homogenization
Awwwards SOTY 2019-2025 rewarding interaction-as-design over palette (Bruno Simon 2019, Lusion 2023, Igloo Inc 2024, Lando Norris 2025)
626's own About star map already fetches data/plugin-versions.json at runtime: the pattern is proven in-tree
directions.risk: The numbers are modest and public (installers in the hundreds, store data lagging 2-3 days), and a panel of modest figures can read as a dashboard nobody asked for. The contract still requires home.html to carry all twelve SITE_JSON zones, so the brochure survives below the panel. freeze-theme.py copies rendered HTML, so a runtime-fetched panel in the frozen archive would show current numbers, breaking the site as it looked; the panel either inlines a snapshot at render time or the freeze learns to. theme-doctor's zero-console-error gate means every fetch needs a silent fallback.
directions.verdict_reason: The six cited signals are real and dated, but none points at a live-data home page. Count-as-hero is verified live (Glama 94,748 servers, Smithery Browse 24,559+ MCPs), yet the convergence packet itself lists logo wall or count as a slop trait, so this evidence supports the thing the direction claims to leave; 626's own figures make it worse (site-stats.json: 683 visits in 30 days; download-stats.json: vibe-cartographer 2 downloads / 0 installers, Vibe-Doc 0/0, RTClickPng 0/0, and the one big number, ROROROblox 55,592, is 99% manifest polling). Linear's hero is product screenshots with no live numbers, a pattern the direction rejects; Vercel/Smithery headlines are vocabulary, not design; arXiv 2603.13036 locates productive friction in the creator-LLM prompting loop and says nothing about output pages or data; the four Awwwards SOTY winners are WebGL interaction portfolios, which argues for a Three.js hero as readily as a stat panel. The only multi-source precedent for metrics-as-homepage is the Open Startup movement (Baremetrics 2014-02, Buffer 2014), twelve years old, and the visual register (mono at display size, cool dark panel, cyan as live indicator, tabular figures) is Phosphor Terminal / Signal Noise (Design/explorations/2026-07-07), Long Now Terminal (2026-07-12) and the Phosphor Blueprint CRT theme archived 2026-10-01, re-coated with a dashboard. Add the build cost the direction concedes and this is a heavy lift toward a cell the lab has already rotated off.
directions.survives_as: A render-time-stamped instrument strip, not a home-page thesis: a single dated row of shipped versions and last-shipped stamps (plugin-versions.json plus the fact tokens site.json already carries), inlined at render so the frozen archive stays honest, placed inside whichever remix wins (Field Manual fits it best as a data block in a manual). Quote installers and dates, never totals or visits. The provenance idea is worth keeping; the panel-as-page, Martian Mono display face, and cool-panel palette are the September theme returning in a new coat.

build: Refraction (light ground, glass demoted to one accent)
recommendation.why: Three surfaces that do not share a pole: Field Manual is warm paper and matte (cluster 1, with the method carrying the distance); Cyan Ground is a saturated mid-value field, the one value no sampled site and no prompt occupies; the light cold ground from Refraction is lit, pale and colored, the opposite of both paper and glow. Fold the other two in: Recursive on the MONO axis into Field Manual's tables, and a dated version strip into whichever sheet wins, inlined at render. If the magenta band fails the contrastPairs gate, Cyan Ground enters band-free.

observations.look: Camphor type (Fonts In Use, in place until the 2020 redesign), white field, rotated/angled hero gradient as the brand signature; the angle and color stops are recalled.
Flat vector illustration: small heads, long bendy limbs, off-natural skin tones on flat backgrounds. Facebook's Alegria by Buck dated 2017; Google, Slack, WeTransfer, MoneyFarm listed as adopters.

Camphor on white; hero gradient animated by a small WebGL class (minigl) driven by four CSS-variable colors, per Hufnagl's 2020 tutorial. No typeface or launch year given, so the high-water-mark framing is recalled.
Raw system fonts, default blue links, harsh contrast, deliberate anti-polish. Curation start and 2022 relabel unconfirmed (source 403).
Camphor replaced by Klim's Soehne in the 2020 redesign, a more geometric look many tech sites have been favoring (Fonts In Use). White field and gradient identity continue (gradient recalled).

Soft UI: monochrome shapes extruded from one surface with paired light and dark shadows. Term coined 2019 (Jason Kelly); HarmonyOS (Aug 2019) and Big Sur (Nov 2020) showed touches. Criticized for contrast; adoption fell by 2021.

Frosted translucent panels with backdrop blur and a thin light border; emerged as the popular aesthetic after neumorphism faded and persisted into the mid-2020s. Absorption into dark SaaS cards is recalled.
Critics called it lazy; by 2022 companies were returning to 3D skeuomorphism, and by 2023 Creative Bloq (via Wikipedia) said its popularity collapsed and it was used as parody.
Thick black outlines, hard offset shadows, saturated flat color, playful type, Gumroad-style. Source 403, so naming date and Gumroad link unverified.
Claimed first bento-style tile grid on apple.com/iphone: mixed-size rounded tiles, one feature each. Source 403, 2022 date unverified.

Per LogRocket: dark mode, bold typography, complex gradients, high contrast, glassmorphism effects, monochrome scheme. Its 2025 iteration reduced color further, from dull monochrome blue to near black/white.

LogRocket names these as following the Linear-style recipe in 2024-2025: Reflect dark mode, Stripe alternative palettes, Wise bold type, Raycast moving from gradients to bold red with abstract noise overlays, GitHub's 2025 changes judged unsuccessful. The article says many SaaS sites now resemble each other.

observations.site: Notion / Cursor / Linear / Vercel / Framer (bento roundups)
observations.look: SuperDesign states these are cited in bento listicles but none currently run bento homepages. Bento is a templated, listicle pattern more than what leading sites shipped.

Tinted cream canvas #faf9f5 chosen against the cool gray-white of other AI brands; serif display (Copernicus / Tiempos Headline class, weight 400, negative tracking) over StyreneB-or-Inter body; coral #cc785c accent; JetBrains Mono code. Year is an estimate from a third-party spec repo; the neighborhood snapshot puts the look on disk 2023-06.

2025 brand refresh introduced OpenAI Sans, a custom geometric sans from ABC Dinamo with the in-house team, five weights with italics, deliberately imperfect O for warmth; wordmark now outranks the Blossom symbol; motion by Studio Dumbar.

Design system documented as Anthropic Serif / Sans / Mono (Georgia, Inter, JetBrains Mono as fallbacks). Marketing surface is slate ink #141413 on ivory cream #faf9f5, full-bleed black bands alternating with cream sections, dormant accents (Clay #d97757, Fig, Cactus, Sky).

Unveiled at WWDC 2025 as a system-wide material (iOS 26, macOS Tahoe, visionOS). Refracts and re-tints the background and shifts with scroll or tilt, unlike glassmorphism's static blur; real refraction lives in Apple's rendering stack.
Describes strategic minimalism with oversized assertive type, dark-mode interfaces, embedded clickable product walkthroughs, and storytelling backed by proof and logos. Low-authority SEO content.

observations.site: Smashing Magazine, Using Gradients In UX Design (2018-01-25)
observations.look: Gradients vanished in the flat-design era and returned via Material Design and Instagram's logo redesign, with Spotify as a current example. Advice: two colors, not more than three. Live fetch of a dated source.

observations.site: Smashing Magazine, Art Directing For The Web With CSS Grid Template Areas (2018-04-09)
observations.look: Argues for print-style art direction using grid-template-areas, with a hardboiled-detective layout demo; the tooling for asymmetric layouts.

observations.site: Awwwards Sites of the Year 2018: Orano, koox, Frans Hals Museum, Active Theory v4
observations.look: Winner list confirmed. Brand/corporate, museum and WebGL-studio sites. Per-site visual details not verified.

Recalled: white field, slanted gradient-mesh hero band in blue/purple/pink, geometric sans, generous whitespace, three-column feature rows. Overpass Studio (2025) names Stripe and Linear as the originators of the premium-minimal SaaS template.

observations.site: Awwwards Sites of the Year 2019: Bruno Simon Portfolio, MA, The Cool Club x FWA, Nomadic Tribe
observations.look: Winner list confirmed. Bruno Simon's portfolio is a WebGL drivable 3D car, an experimental-interaction pick.
Recalled, unverified: custom flat illustration systems with chunky characters, saturated brand color and rounded sans, spreading to mainstream SaaS and fintech by 2019-2020.

observations.site: Awwwards Sites of the Year 2020: Mammut Expedition Baikal, Kode Sports Club, Dark (Netflix guide), Synchronized, Pioneer Corn Revolutionized
observations.look: Winner list confirmed. Mostly narrative/scrollytelling and brand-campaign microsites.

observations.site: Webflow, Neumorphism: Its rise and fall in UI design
observations.look: Fetch failed (parse error). Recalled: soft extruded one-tone surfaces from a 2020 Dribbble banking-app concept, faded on contrast grounds, never reached production sites.

observations.site: Apple macOS Big Sur and the glassmorphism wave
observations.look: Apple used frosted translucent glass in Big Sur (2020), with Microsoft Fluent Acrylic as precursor. Glassmorphism named as a component-level effect for dashboard cards, login and onboarding screens, with warnings about blur cost and contrast.

observations.site: Awwwards Sites of the Year 2021: Pangram Pangram Foundry, Star Atlas, Prometheus Fuels, Umami Land, Chungi Folio
observations.look: Winner list confirmed (five winners). Mix of type-foundry, crypto/game and illustrated-brand sites.

Recalled: near-black field, Inter, subtle purple-blue glow, hairline borders, product screenshot hero, copied by dev-tool and AI startups from about 2022. Overpass Studio (2025) names Linear as a template-setter for dark minimal SaaS. The neighborhood snapshot dates the look to 2020-06.

observations.site: Awwwards Sites of the Year 2022: KPR, The Other Side of Truth, Persepolis Reimagined
observations.look: Winner list confirmed. The immersive narrative/WebGL characterization is from titles and recall.
Predicts claymorphism, brutalism, Material Design 3, retro/pixel aesthetics, serif comeback, italics for emphasis, visible borders, mixed horizontal and vertical scroll.

A May 2025 Bejamas explainer names Figma and Gumroad as the best-known neubrutalist examples: thick black outlines, offset shadows, flat geometric shapes, clashing high-contrast colors, bold quirky type. The 2022-2023 peak is recalled.

observations.site: Awwwards Sites of the Year 2023: Lusion v3, Noomo Agency, Mana Yerba Mate
observations.look: Winner list confirmed. WebGL/3D studios plus a packaging-style product site.

observations.site: Awwwards Sites of the Year 2024: Igloo Inc, Don't Board Me, Opal Tadpole
observations.look: Winner list confirmed. Per-site claims about scroll-driven 3D and illustration are recalled from titles.

14 trends: neo-brutalism and anti-design, nostalgic retro and Y2K, hand-drawn illustration, accessibility, animated graphics, gradients and glassmorphism, custom cursors, app-like UX, dark mode, microinteractions, bold type with vibrant palettes, parallax, horizontal scroll, asymmetric layouts. The intro still says 2023, so largely recycled.

observations.site: Awwwards Site of the Year 2025: Lando Norris (OFF+BRAND) and Messenger
observations.look: Agency page confirms Webflow plus WebGL plus Rive, cinematic scrolling and speed-inspired transitions. Palette is neon yellow (#D2FF00) on black (#111112), accent-on-dark. Awards: SOTY, SOTM, SOTD, FWA, CSSDA.

25 trends including neubrutalism, glassmorphism, claymorphism, isometric, bento grids, retro 70s-90s, organic shapes, kinetic type, micro-animations, AI personalization and new maximalism. Says dark mode, parallax and whitespace are permanent standards. Names recycle 2020-2023 trends.

observations.site: Overpass Studio, Why SaaS Websites Look The Same (2025-12-17, updated 2026-05-12)
observations.look: Names SaaS sameness patterns: dark backgrounds with minimal white text, centered hero with vague benefit headline, product UI mockups on soft gradients, three-word taglines. Credits Stripe and Linear as the template; blames templates, no-code builders, A/B-tested patterns and vibe-coding.

observations.site: Shuffle.dev, Why Do Most AI-Generated Websites Look the Same? (2026-01-29)
observations.look: Argues AI predicts the most frequent patterns. The default is hero, three feature cards, testimonials, pricing, CTA. Blames vague prompts and recommends explicit constraints.

Source-verified tokens: indigo #6772e5 primary (15 uses) with #87bbfd sky, #b9f4bc mint and #f6a4eb pink accents, light-weight humanist sans, white field. Re-fetched in verification: hex counts match. The angled gradient-mesh hero and layout are recalled, not viewed.
Nearly unchanged from 2018: same #6772e5/#87bbfd/#b9f4bc token set, same 300-600 sans weights, same white field. The flagship look held two years before the dev-tool wave copied it.
Teal-green accents (#6dd7b9, #00b4b6, #2383ae) on white; a tiny 12KB docs landing with minimal chrome. Pre-Inter, pre-dark-mode docs era.
Plain 29KB single page, headline Hello! I'm Brittany Chiang, a design-minded front-end... Pre-navy-and-teal baseline for the solo-portfolio genre.

Title Develop. Preview. Ship.; Geist component classes throughout, #eaeaea hairlines (17 uses), #0070f3 blue, #79ffe1 mint and #ff0080 magenta accents; black-and-white monochrome with one color pop. Re-fetched: tokens and title confirmed. Origin of the Inter + black/white dev-tool default.

#5e6ad2 indigo as the single dominant color (37 uses) on near-black #1c1d1f; The issue tracking tool you'll enjoy using. Dark UI with one saturated purple-blue brand color, the template for a thousand copies.
Palette expands to #0ed7b5 teal and #2298bd, yellow #faf089 accents; 117KB page, A utility-first CSS framework for rapidly building custom designs. Colorful, light, illustrative.
Same #5e6ad2 indigo plus #8a8f98 grey and #d0d6e0 text. Refinement, not change; dark UI with soft grey text is now the dev-tool dialect.

Snapshot loads but the archived HTML carries no extractable color, font or border tokens. Gumroad as an early commercial face of neobrutalism (flat pink, thick black borders, offset shadows) is recalled, not confirmed.
Inter as an explicit family (63 uses), animated gradient text on the headline words (each with its own --start-color), #0a72ef blue, #ff5b4f, #de1d8d. Gradient-as-type is the era's signature.
Dark field with #3ecf8e green and #569cd6 / #272822 code-editor syntax colors (Monokai / VS Code Dark+) as decoration; Build in a weekend. Scale to millions. Code-as-hero-ornament.

Navy #0a192f / #112340 field, #a2aabc slate text, teal accent, Calibre sans body plus SF Mono for small labels. The widely cloned dark navy + teal + mono labels developer-portfolio template (mass-forking recalled).

Title A better way to build products; #000212 near-black field, #6663f6 / #7877c6 violet glows, #f7f8f8 text, #8a8f98 grey, Inter. Re-fetched: tokens confirmed. Dark + purple radial glow + Inter fully formed.
#0c1120 dark navy with #38bdf8 sky-blue and slate greys (#e2e8f0, #94a3b8); the docs site adopts the dark navy + sky glow look it ships.

Warm off-white #fafaf7 field (8 uses), #191919 ink, #cc785c terracotta accent, Styrene A/B sans for UI and Tiempos Text serif for reading. Re-fetched: all confirmed. The warm-paper-plus-clay palette now copied across the neighborhood starts here.
#f6f5f0 warm cream background on an editor landing page, Code at the speed of thought. An early dev-tool site on warm paper rather than black.
Inter (154 uses) plus Jua and IBM Plex Sans in templates; #0099ff blue, #9900ff purple; 1.5MB page. Template-builder output standardises on Inter + blue/violet accent.
Hero text Vercel is the Frontend Cloud; gradient-text era over, palette resolves to #2c8ce1 and #45dec4 with framework-logo colors; 1.1MB page. Fewer glows, more logo walls and product screenshots.
Early MCP registry (Dec 2024): shadcn-style text-muted-foreground tokens, VS Code Dark+ syntax colors #9cdcfe on #1e1e1e. The MCP directory genre starts as a default shadcn dark theme.

Title Plan and build products; palette collapses to near-pure grayscale: #ffffff, #000000, #1a1c1f, #e2e4e6, #949698; InterVariable; 2.4MB page of product-UI imagery. Re-fetched: confirmed. The purple is gone; the product screenshot is the decoration.
The AI Code Editor; orange #f28c1f / #cc8013 and magenta #eb348c / #c91657 / #a41f7e gradient stops (dozens of repeats, a gradient-heavy mark/graphic set).
Build something Lovable with an orange-pink-magenta-blue gradient set: #ff8e63, #ff7eb0, #ff66f4, #4b73ff, #fe7b02. The vibe-coding builder's own site is gradient-saturated.
Black field with #ff4d94 hot pink and #6366f1 indigo accents, 309KB; Find Awesome MCP Servers and Clients. Directory sites default to Tailwind-color accents (indigo-500 is #6366f1).
#08090a near-black, #e2e4e7 text, with #f79ce0 pink and #55cdff cyan as small spot accents; The system for product development. Dark, grayscale, tiny pastel accents.
#f0eee6 warm paper, #141413 ink, #d97757 clay accent, #b0aea5 / #87867f warm greys, custom Anthropic Serif display face. The reference point the whole neighborhood now pulls toward.

Moves from the 2025 gradient set to warm neutrals (#edecec 24 uses, #14120b brown-black, #cac6be, #47433c) and a --font-serif stack of Iowan Old Style / Palatino Linotype / URW Palladio; headline Cursor is your coding agent for building ambitious software. Re-fetched: all confirmed. Warm-paper-plus-serif adopted by a dev-tool leader.

Cream #fcfbf8, #fef3c7 amber and #78350f brown (one use each, thin evidence of dominance), Camera Plain Variable display face (confirmed in the font file name); title AI App Builder. Gradient-saturated 2025 site reads as warm cream in 2026, from tokens only.

Explicit --font-serif / --font-sans / --font-mono triple, serif headline at clamp(28px,4vw,40px), #1a1c1a-like ink with #9a4a3a rust and #c96a50 / #e89a7a clay, #5a5a5a greys. A Claude plugin directory copying Anthropic's warm clay-and-serif look.
Playfair Display serif headings, #e8533e / #d64531 vermilion accent on #fafafa, light-weight slate-500 body; The Essential Marketplace for Claude Plugins. Serif + one warm red-orange on near-white.

Tailwind color accents (#6d28d9 violet, #c2410c orange, #1d4ed8 blue, #0e7490 cyan, #047857 emerald) as category chips; The largest Claude Code plugin directory. Still the default Tailwind-palette directory.
Tailwind amber/emerald/orange/blue chip colors (#ffd93d, #f59e0b, #10b981, #f97316, #3b82f6), 1.35MB page; dense card directory.
Inter, #131d2e navy-black, #37a169 and #00d992 greens, grey #7d8284; Popular MCP Servers with 69,796 servers listed. Dark-navy-plus-green data table.
Give agents more agency; #ff8c32 / #ff5601 orange accents, system sans. Registry moves from 2024 shadcn-dark to an orange brand.
#0f172a (Tailwind slate-900) with bg-teal-400 accents (37 uses) and bg-slate-800/900, Inter. The 2022 navy + teal portfolio is intact four years on, now mapped onto Tailwind's built-in colors.
Title Agentic Infrastructure; Geist mono tokens, #fafafa. The headline vocabulary moves from Frontend Cloud to agents.

Resend: #000000 black with #a0a0a0 grey text and warm #c7c2bc accent. Zed: #1b1e23 dark with #4482f8 blue. Raycast: black/white with #070d4f / #523091 purple gradients. Black field + grey text + one cool accent remains the majority dev-tool default. Evidence URL covers Resend only.

Space Grotesk display, Inter body, JetBrains Mono labels (font files confirmed), #050c18 absolute-black navy with #17d4fa cyan and #f22f89 magenta, CRT scanlines over a drafting grid. Distinctive treatment built on the same Space Grotesk + Inter + mono + dark-navy-with-cyan kit the dev-tool pack uses.

Live tokens: slate ground #3A4350, ink #F7F5F0, matte, fixed paper grain at z-index 5, newspaper furniture (hairline and heavy rules, folio tabs, color bar), --sb-serif / --sb-display / --sb-mono, cyan #17D4FA as link ink, no glow or gradient. Thesis: The page is printed, not lit. Same card-and-section content structure as before.

observations.site: Tailwind CSS / Tailwind UI (origin of the indigo default)
observations.look: Tailwind UI demos used bg-indigo-500/600 buttons, indigo links and indigo-to-purple gradients on white with a neutral sans, a placeholder accent that spread via tutorials and templates. 925 Studios dates it from 2019; the DEV write-up puts the Tailwind UI launch around 2020.

Adam Wathan's August 2025 tweet apologizes for making every Tailwind UI button bg-indigo-500 five years earlier, leading to every AI generated UI on earth also being indigo. Re-confirmed by two independent write-ups (DEV, Wheels Up Collective).

observations.site: Claude, no-skill landing page default (Anthropic's own account)
observations.look: Anthropic's blog post dated 2025-11-12 opens: an LLM asked for a landing page without guidance will almost always conform to Inter fonts, purple gradients on white backgrounds, and minimal animations.

observations.site: Anthropic cookbook: prompting for frontend aesthetics
observations.look: Tells the model to avoid overused families (Inter, Roboto, Arial, system fonts) and separately warns You still tend to converge on common choices (Space Grotesk, for example). Lists Space Grotesk under a code-aesthetic suggestion and recommends alternatives (Playfair Display, Crimson Pro, Fraunces, Clash Display, Satoshi, Bricolage Grotesque, Newsreader, IBM Plex).

Five clusters AI design clusters around: (1) warm cream near #F4F1EA, high-contrast serif display, terracotta accent near #D97757; (2) near-black with a single acid-green or vermilion accent; (3) broadsheet layout with hairline rules, zero border-radius, dense newspaper columns; (4) SaaS card kit: identical rounded cards, one border-radius on everything, same soft grey shadow rgba(0,0,0,.1); (5) template chrome: tracked-out all-caps labels, middle-dot meta strings, spaced em dashes, tinted near-blacks #0B0B0B/#111, mono data labels, arrow suffixes on links. Item 5 describes 626labs.dev's own chrome.

Names the three looks (warm cream + serif + terracotta; near-black + acid-green/vermilion; broadsheet hairlines), says the skill replaced font blacklists with failure-mode descriptions, about 55 lines of prose, 825,477 installs as of 2026-08-27 (third most-installed agent skill).
Capture dated 2025-03-06. The prompt says v0 avoids indigo or blue unless specified, uses shadcn/ui unless told otherwise, and always uses lucide-react for icons.

All three converge on near-identical defaults: violet/indigo primary (#7c3aed range), Inter or similar neutral sans, 8-12px card radius, centered hero plus three-card feature row, Lucide icons, because they share Tailwind, shadcn/ui and model priors. Bolt most generic, Lovable most opinionated with stronger gradients, v0 reads as shadcn. Conflicts with v0's prompt and with the Lovable gallery data.

Playfair Display 36.6% (26 sites), Inter 16.9% (12), serif heading with sans body 53.9%, white/near-white backgrounds 83.7% (103), centered-text layout 19.1% (25), bold saturation 3.3%, muted 55.3%, monochrome 41.5%. Builders converge on bright, paper-white canvases with type and photography carrying the design. Curated gallery, selection bias likely.

observations.site: Claude Design default output (Michal Malewicz via The Ad Pharm)
observations.look: Confirmed: purple gradients on white as an AI-slop fingerprint, centered hero with eyebrow plus 64-pt headline plus subhead plus two CTAs, Space Grotesk named as a common convergence point, and the remark that Claude Design's own marketing logo falls into the trap. Generic glassmorphism also listed among the defaults.

67 tells in seven categories (second-order defaults, typography, color, layout, components, motion, icons/copy/imagery), each with a detection signal and fixes for plain HTML/CSS and React+Tailwind+shadcn. Confirmed: worn Lucide set, sparkle-for-AI icons, decorative 01/02/03 numbering.

Claims three in five AI-startup landing pages now load Geist-Variable.woff2 (author's claim, unverified) and calls Geist Sans + Geist Mono + a bg-zinc-950 dark hero the modern equivalent of the Bootstrap template.
Confirms Inter and Geist as the most frequent fonts; Geist rides the Next.js/Vercel boilerplate and current Next.js docs; shadcn's typography examples also use Geist and Geist Mono.

observations.site: Why AI Websites All Look the Same (Wheels Up Collective)
observations.look: Names purple-indigo gradients, Inter, rounded cards, bg-indigo-500 buttons; says AI is averaging Tailwind-based pages; quotes Wathan's apology; cites a University of Washington study on reproduced dominant style patterns.

observations.site: UW paper Interrogating Design Homogenization in Web Vibe Coding (arXiv 2603.13036, 2026-03-13)
observations.look: Authors Shin, Gao, Pang, Lee, Reinecke, Tseng. Combines sociotechnical risk analysis with case studies and proposes productive friction as an intervention against homogenization. Only the abstract page was read.

Lists left-border cards as a banned pattern and explicitly bans emoji icons (rocket, lightning, sparkle) under Instant-Death Signature Detection. Frames tells as a combination (3+ tells such as purple gradient + Inter + centered hero).

Defines AI slop as Inter, indigo-to-purple gradients and three rounded cards; ties it to Tailwind popularizing indigo-500 from 2019; says Linear, Stripe and Duolingo escape through deliberate type and visual choices.

Confirms a standardized machine-readable .lovable/design-system.json (tokens, component catalog, stack constraints) and tokens in src/index.css and Tailwind. Does not mention shadcn. The default-override-at-template-layer point holds.

Weakly supported. Anti-AI-UI explicitly bans emoji icons; avoid-ai-design, SKILL.md and the Claude Design write-up do not name emoji. A minor, single-source tell rather than a confirmed cross-tool default.
